top_choice_rationale: P001 honours one coherent chemical idea, small-molecule-induced proximity between an E3 ligase and a target, which converts drug action from occupancy to catalytic removal and rests on ternary-complex physical chemistry. Both strands (PROTAC design by Crews and Deshaies, cereblon as the thalidomide target by Handa) are independently reproduced over two decades and the glue strand already underlies approved medicines. The costs are attribution (Sakamoto, Ciulli and others omitted) and no approved bifunctional degrader, but no one disputes the science. P002 is the mature, cleanly attributed fallback; P004 is mature but a third computational prize; P003 joins two separate chemical-biology achievements with a contested base-editing priority and still-maturing clinical data.
